# Vendored MalverdeSoftware packages

Exact, packed versions of the shared MalverdeSoftware packages, installed with `npm install --save-exact`. They are committed here so a fresh clone builds without any other checkout. See the [consumer guide](https://github.com/MalverdeSoftware/malverdesoftware/blob/main/docs/CONSUMING.md) for upgrading and rolling back.

Commit hashes refer to the private development history of the shared packages (`MalverdeSoftware/malverdesoftware-history`); the public repository starts at its first public release.

| Tarball | Version | Packed from |
|---|---|---|
| `malverdesoftware-sealed-envelope-0.1.1.tgz` | 0.1.1 | MalverdeSoftware/malverdesoftware `46ce585` |
| `malverdesoftware-relay-0.1.0.tgz` | 0.1.0 | MalverdeSoftware/malverdesoftware `25c86fc` |
| `malverdesoftware-session-client-0.1.2.tgz` | 0.1.2 | MalverdeSoftware/malverdesoftware `46ce585` |
| `malverdesoftware-ui-0.1.1.tgz` | 0.1.1 | MalverdeSoftware/malverdesoftware `2c4bbce` |

The shared packages are Apache-2.0, copyright The Johns Hopkins University. From ui 0.1.1 on, each tarball contains LICENSE and NOTICE; earlier tarballs predate that.
